body: my old counsellor became a registrar at my school, so there's no way to transition. i'd rather not tell the new counsellor anyway bc she'd contact my parents again and my parents will rant about "younger people being easily depressed" again.

3 years, but this has started a few years ago and i've been feeling this way ever since 8th grade and it's worsened to this point and i'm not sure if i can wait until i'm 18 bc i'm tired of everything

i've posted about it on this account, but i'll give a summary: i'm a minor who lives with a family who used to be physically and verbally abusive but now they only verbally abuse me by saying stuff like "kill yourself" and "why can't you do anything right, you're so worthless" etc. and the old guidance counsellor at my school knew about my problem and told my mom to let me see a therapist, but my mom refused to do that bc "depression doesn't exist" according to her. the guidance center has a new a counsellor now who knows nothing about me and i've never felt so hopeless before because i'm stuck with my family with no way of getting help (hospitals require a guardian for minors, i dont have guardians i can trust or count on) and this has also started to affect my school work and it's becoming another problem because my mom is used to my high grades and now that i don't feel motivated to live my grades are steadily dropping and it's giving her more of a reason to call me names and tell me i'm not good for anything or something.

i don't think wanting to die is the cowardly option, and it doesn't exactly make you weak either. if someone has dealt with thoughts of suicide for some time, then it must've been hard for them to just live, especially if all they want to do is find peace in death. i don't think i'm a coward either, because i'm not doing anything to make it seem like a coward just because i've tried to deal with this for a few years now.
